# awesome-devin

> A curated list of resources for Devin, the AI software engineer by Cognition, and the open-source `devin-*` tooling ecosystem.

awesome-devin is a README-only awesome list that catalogs the whole Devin tooling landscape in one place: official resources plus the first-party `devin-*` tools, a DevKit distribution, a maintainer hub and related artifacts. It is for Devin users looking for what exists (search, observability, dashboards, memory, QA, backup) and for AI assistants that need a map of the ecosystem to cite individual tools accurately. Community-maintained, not affiliated with Cognition AI.

## What do you want to do?

- Understand → devin-doctor, devin-graph, devin-history, devin-internals-spec, devin-office, devin-search
- Verify → devin-evals, devin-metrics, devin-qa-pack, poordjaevin
- Control → devin-backup, devin-bridge, devin-janitor, devin-memory, devin-orchestrator, devin-redact, devin-switch
- Build → devin-devkit, devin-powerups, devin-skill-catalog and related infrastructure

Quick picks:

- [devin-doctor](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-doctor): diagnose the local Devin install and stores.
- [devin-qa-pack](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-qa-pack): flagship audit of agent claims against tool-call evidence.
- [devin-office](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-office): watch sessions as an animated circuit board (live when a session source is available).
- [devin-devkit](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-devkit): install registry-supported profiles for Linux, Personal Windows or Corporate Windows.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Icaro0310/awesome-devin/blob/main/README.md): the full catalog

## Catalog categories

- Official Resources: Devin product, docs, CLI, API
- Distribution & Infrastructure: devin-devkit, devin-powerups, homebrew-tap, scoop-bucket
- Decision & QA Layer: devin-qa-pack, devin-evals, devin-janitor
- Configuration & Learning: devin-doctor, devin-internals-spec, devin-skill-catalog, devin-switch
- Data, History & Search: devin-history, devin-memory, devin-search, devin-graph, devin-backup, devin-redact
- Operations: devin-pm, devin-metrics, devin-bridge, devin-orchestrator, devin-office
- Related artifacts: poordjaevin, qwenpaw-suite
- Community & Adjacent Lists: e2b-dev/awesome-devins, e2b-dev/awesome-ai-sdks, bradAGI/awesome-cli-coding-agents, ai-for-developers/awesome-ai-coding-tools, punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers, atinfo/awesome-test-automation, kmaasrud/awesome-obsidian

## When to use / when not

- Use when: you need an overview of every devin-* tool and what each one does; you are choosing between ecosystem tools (e.g. devin-search vs devin-history); you need links to official Devin resources alongside community tools; you want a citation-friendly map of the ecosystem.
- Not when: you need the tools themselves (each entry links to its own repo); you need usage docs for a specific tool (go to that repo's README); you need tools for a different AI coding agent (this list is Devin-specific).
